career_ladder.note: DRDO Centre for Personnel Talent Management (CEPTAM) recruits technical staff under the Defence Research Technical Cadre (DRTC). Senior Technical Assistant 'B' (STA-B) enters at 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 6, while Technician 'A' (Tech-A) enters at Level 2. Promotions in DRDO are regulated through merit-based assessment under DRTC rules without reference to vacancies.

steps.designation: Senior Technical Assistant 'B' (STA-B, Group B Non-Gazetted)

steps.source_label: DRTC Assessment Rules — STA-B to TO-A

exam_scheme.note: DRDO CEPTAM examination for DRTC posts is conducted in two tiers. For STA-B: Tier-I is a Computer Based Test (CBT) for screening (120 objective questions, 120 marks, 90 minutes) covering Quantitative Ability, Reasoning, General Awareness, English Language, and General Science, with candidates shortlisted in a 1:8 ratio. Tier-II is a CBT for provisional selection based on the specific technical subject (100 questions, 100 marks, 90 minutes). For Tech-A: Tier-I CBT is selection-based (120 questions across common and trade sections) followed by a qualifying Trade Test (Tier-II). There is no negative marking.

stages.stage_name: Tier-I: Computer Based Test (Screening for STA-B)

papers.paper_name: CBT Screening: Quantitative Ability, Reasoning, General Awareness, English & General Science
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking (+1 mark per correct answer)
papers.qualifying_threshold: Shortlisting in 1:8 ratio for Tier-II selection (minimum 40% UR/OBC, 35% SC/ST)

stages.stage_name: Tier-II: Computer Based Test (Provisional Selection for STA-B)

papers.paper_name: CBT Subject-Specific Test (Domain Engineering / Science Discipline)
papers.negative_marking: No negative marking (+1 mark per correct answer)
papers.qualifying_threshold: 100% weightage for final merit list; minimum qualifying 40% UR/OBC, 35% SC/ST

financial_package.note: Senior Technical Assistant 'B' posts in DRDO are categorized under central 7th CPC Pay Matrix Level 6 (entry basic ₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400). Technician 'A' posts are categorized under Level 2 (entry basic ₹19,900 to ₹63,200). Personnel are entitled to Central Government allowances including DA, HRA, Transport Allowance, and DRDO establishment facilities.
financial_package.pay_source_label: DRDO CEPTAM-10/DRTC Detailed Advertisement — STA-B Pay Scale
financial_package.estimate_note: Basic pay ₹35,400 + 58% DA (₹20,532) + HRA (10%-30% based on station class: ₹3,540 to ₹10,620) + Transport Allowance (₹2,844 to ₹5,688) yields gross ~₹62,000 to ~₹76,000. In-hand reflects ~10% NPS deduction and standard deductions.
official_perks: Government-funded residential quarters in DRDO colonies / townships or central HRA
Comprehensive medical cover under Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) or DRDO MI Room facilities
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% monthly government matching contribution
Children Education Allowance (CEA) of ₹2,250 per month per child and Leave Travel Concession (LTC)
Canteen Stores Department (CSD) canteen amenities across DRDO establishment locations
